title: Quietly Smoky Indian Chicken Thali
description: A light and flavorful Indian dish featuring smoky paprika and tandoor spices, served on a wooden board in a traditional thali format, with a yeasty and glassy-jelly texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the smoky paprika, tandoor spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned on all sides.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and bake in the oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a small bowl, sprinkle the yeast over 1 tablespoon of warm water and let sit for 5 minutes, or until frothy.
In a separate bowl, mix together the gelatin and 1 tablespoon of cold water, then add the yeast mixture and stir to combine.
Spoon the gelatin mixture over the cooked chicken and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve on a wooden board in a traditional thali format.
